name: Dual-Principal GitHub App Admission
summary: Require both selected GitHub App capability and the authenticated customer's actual repository authority before admitting an App-backed write objective.
problem: Installation-token repository metadata can be mistaken for the customer's push permission, either rejecting valid work or letting App capability stand in for user authority.
coreOutcomes: Explicit App and customer principal separation
Regression coverage and scoped fresh admission
requirements: Validated App grants for the intended operation
boundaries: App installation does not grant customer writer authority
Repository selection and read discovery do not prove objective admission
Missing or mismatched role evidence fails closed
This workflow never grants or broadens permissions
